task.name: Climate dynamics: unresolved-tendency closure
task.description: Fit a shared degree-five polynomial approximation to the unresolved fast-scale forcing of a two-scale Lorenz-96 model. Train on supplied slow-state/tendency pairs and minimize normalized error on independent validation trajectories, including an unseen forcing regime.
task.contract: construct(training_x, training_subgrid_tendency) -> 6 finite real polynomial coefficients in ASCENDING powers of local slow state x, approximating the unresolved tendency as sum(c_i*x**i). Inputs are flattened paired samples from two independent spun-up trajectories at F=6,8. Reference uses Rasp (2020) two-scale Lorenz-96 with K=8,J=4,h=1,c=10,b=10: dX=advection-X+F-h*c*mean(Y); dY=c*(-b*Y_(j+1)*(Y_(j+2)-Y_(j-1))-Y+h*X/J). Fast indices form one periodic K*J ring, crossing slow-cell boundaries. Score is mean validation MSE/variance(true tendency) over three independent trajectories at F=6,8,10. Units nondimensional. Coefficients must be a single shared polynomial for every cell and forcing.
